integrity: Analytical proof uses exact affine incidence and Walsh identities plus the classical hypergeometric CLT; exact finite checks supplement but do not certify infinite conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Covers inclusion orders at most three and a half-sampling-fraction subsequence of finite populations; no extension to all higher orders or quantitative Gaussian convergence rate is claimed. Independent novelty assessment is not performed.
title: Maximal sampling-law separation despite matching three inclusion orders
